blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Seventeen senior high school STEM students from Valencia National High School (VNHS) who qualified for an international science competition in South Korea are facing a major roadblock: steep travel costs that may keep them from competing. After hauling in 17 medals—10 golds, five silvers, and two bronzes—in the national qualifying rounds, the young scientists earned slots to represent the Philippines at the International Science Olympiad Competition of Southeast Asia (ISOCSEA) finals in Goyang, South Korea, on December 18 to 22. However, airfare, visa processing, and registration fees run between PHP 100,000 and PHP 150,000 per participant, said Ace […]...
